literal: fikʼrenya = sweetheart/partner, the ordinary word for a romantic partner regardless of marriage; the demonstrative and copula agree with the introduced partner's own gender (yih...new masc. / yīhich...nat fem. in text_alt), not the speaker's, exactly as this pack's own yih balē new / yīhich mīstē nat husband/wife rows already do
text_alt is for a female colleague, agreeing on the demonstrative and copula as family-intros.this-is-my-partner does
